meta.title: Find a draft event or project — it is on the Drafts tab
gaps: Verify that every saved field, including all sheet values and participant details, is restored exactly when the draft reopens.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify that every saved field, including all sheet values and participant details, is restored exactly when the draft reopens.

plan.title: Find Draft Event on Drafts Tab

steps.note: Open the event creation flow for the draft fixture.
Give the draft a searchable title.
Configure the stage with a template so the draft is valid and its saved template can be checked later.
Add a line item so the draft has saved event content.
Populate the pricing sheet before saving the draft.
Commit a schedule required for a usable draft fixture.
Add a participant so the draft represents a complete event setup.
Save the configured event as a draft.
Confirm saving the draft did not produce an application error.
Navigate to the events list where the draft should be discoverable.
Confirm the events list rendered successfully.
Open the Drafts tab required by the case.
Assert the event is listed when searching by its title on Drafts.
Assert the listed event has the Draft badge/status.
Check that the draft is not shown on the Live tab.
Assert the draft title is absent from the Live events table.
Check that the draft is not shown on the History tab.
Assert the draft title is absent from the History events table.
Check that the draft is not shown on the Recurring tab.
Assert the draft title is absent from the Recurring events table.
Return to Drafts before opening the saved event.
Open the matching draft so it should reopen on its create screen.
Assert opening the draft returns to the create screen.
Verify the reopened draft retains its title.
Verify the reopened draft retains its selected template.
Verify the reopened draft retains its line item.
